curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42029-1-2.pdf (book 1, steps 1-60) and omr/instructions/42029-1-1.pdf (book 2, steps 61-109; function pictures on page 65, the optional Power Functions motor on pages 66-78)

functions.does: The black gear on top of the upright axle behind the cab steers the front wheels: a bevel gear at the axle's foot turns a long shaft running forward under the cab, whose 12-tooth gear drives the steering rack and its two links to the front hubs.
functions.source: book 1: the front axle steps; book 2: step 89 (page 36, the knob on top behind the cab); inferred: the gear train, from the model file

functions.does: The steering wheel in the cab turns, but isn't linked to the front wheels.
functions.source: inferred: it sits on its own axle in the dashboard (book 1, step 47) and nothing connects it to the steering shaft

functions.does: As the truck rolls, the rear wheels drive the V6 engine: the rear differential's ring gear turns a long shaft forward, whose 16-tooth gears (one an idler riding loose on the steering shaft) pass the drive up to a shaft that turns the crankshaft, pumping the six pistons up and down.
functions.source: book 1: the rear axle, gearbox and engine steps (engine pages 79-84); inferred: the gear train, from the model file

functions.does: The rear differential lets the two rear wheels turn at different speeds on corners.

The yellow lever inside the cab, on the right behind the seat, works a gearbox under the cab: it slides the driving ring between two clutch gears, choosing whether the black gear low on the right side drives the winch at the front (position 1) or tips the bed (position 2).
functions.source: book 2: page 65 (the inset with the lever's two positions), step 106 (page 61, the yellow arrow at the lever)

functions.does: With the winch chosen, turning the black gear low on the right side, under the door, winds the front winch in or out: the drive goes through 16-tooth gears to the gearbox, then by a shaft and two universal joints forward to a worm, which turns a 24-tooth gear, an 8-tooth gear and the winch reel behind the front bumper.
functions.source: book 2: page 65 (inset 1, the hook on its string), steps 105-106 (pages 60-61, the yellow arrows at the gear); inferred: the gear train, from the model file

functions.does: With the bed chosen, turning the same black gear tips the pick-up bed: the gearbox's other clutch gear drives a shaft and universal joints back to a linear actuator under the bed, which pushes the bed up so it tips back on its hinge at the rear.
functions.source: book 2: page 65 (inset 2, the bed tipped), steps 93-98 (pages 45-54)

functions.does: The bonnet hinges up at its back edge to show the engine.
The front and rear axles are each sprung on two shock absorbers, so they can tilt and rise under the body.
functions.source: inferred: from the two shock absorbers on each axle in the model file (book 1 and book 2 axle steps)
functions.skip: the springs only matter under the truck's weight or a push

functions.does: The optional Power Functions motor and battery box (not in the set) can be fitted to drive the gearbox instead of the black side gear.

questions.question: Which way does each lever go for which function? The `first` amounts in this file are guesses.
